class.name: TweensGdEasing
class.brief_description: Samples easing curves without starting playback.
class.description: Access through [code]Tweens.Easing[/code]. Combine one In and one Out with [code]|[/code], use an InOut pair, or select a single curve. Legacy [code]Tweens.Ease[/code] constants retain their shapes. C# equivalent: [code]Easing[/code].

method.name: evaluate
method.description: Samples [param ease] at [param progress], clamped to [code][0, 1][/code]. Eased weight may overshoot. [param blend] is the centered transition width in [code][0, 1][/code]; zero directly splices the halves. [param blend_type] uses [code]BlendType[/code]. C# equivalent: [code]Easing.Evaluate[/code].
